3. UI Overview

Navbar (fixed)Frosted glass bar. Left: moon + Lunara brand. Centre: 8 nav items with hover dropdowns. Right: search icon + Login/circular avatar button.
Hero SectionFull-viewport purple gradient. Floating moon emoji, giant gradient Lunara title, tagline, Explore + Login buttons, live countdown, 9 Zones, infinity stat. Pulsing glow.
Soundscape9 circular artist cards (Tame Impala, Drake, Pink Floyd, Michael Jackson, Au5, Sabrina Carpenter, Dua Lipa, Sheryl Crow, Tate McRae). Neon-pink hover. Dashed upload box.
PixelLandDashed empty-state: "Be the first to upload". Purple CTA button.
Chat Rooms4 room cards: Global Chat, Private Rooms, Grade-Specific, Study Groups. Cyan hover. Click = login toast.
Tlunara JDM Arcade8 game cards + Community Games section with Valorant, Forza Horizon, Fortnite, Minecraft, Roblox pills + Discord button.
Moon CartOrange risk warning banner. Empty-state box. List an Item button.
Mainline Tech3 room cards: Strategy VC, Study Group, Brainstorm.
Oxide3 chatroom cards: Doubts, Help, Regular Chat.
Oxide CompetitionEmpty-state + Discord CTA.
AboutOrigin story. Founder cards: Arthur (Instagram link), Abhi, Luther (Supporter badge). Contact box.
Login PageTwo-column card. Left: purple gradient + moon. Right: 3-step (avatar circle -> sign in form -> register form).

lunara-login.html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>Lunara — Login</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="lunara-style.css" />
</head>
<body class="login-page">
  <div class="login-wrap">
    <div class="login-left">
      <div class="login-brand">
        <div class="login-logo">🌙</div>
        <h1>Lunara</h1>
        <p>See Beyond. Build Forward.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="login-right">
      <div class="login-step active" id="step-picker">
        <div class="avatar-circle" id="avatarPickerBtn">👤</div>
        <p class="step-hint">Click to sign in</p>
      </div>
      <div class="login-step" id="step-signin">
        <h2>Welcome back</h2>
        <form id="signinForm">
          <input type="email" id="signinEmail" placeholder="Email" required />
          <input type="password" id="signinPassword" placeholder="Password" required />
          <button type="submit" class="btn-primary full">Sign In</button>
        </form>
        <p class="switch-link">No account? <a href="#" onclick="goStep('step-register')">Register</a></p>
        <p class="switch-link"><a href="lunara-site.html">← Back to site</a></p>
      </div>
      <div class="login-step" id="step-register">
        <h2>Create account</h2>
        <form id="registerForm">
          <input type="text" id="regName" placeholder="Display Name" required />
          <input type="email" id="regEmail" placeholder="Email" required />
          <input type="password" id="regPassword" placeholder="Password" required />
          <button type="submit" class="btn-primary full">Register</button>
        </form>
        <p class="switch-link">Have an account? <a href="#" onclick="goStep('step-signin')">Sign In</a></p>
        <p class="switch-link"><a href="lunara-site.html">← Back to site</a></p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <script src="lunara-script.js"></script>
</body>
</html>
lunara-style.css
/* LUNARA HUB — style.css */
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
:root {
  --purple-deep: #0D001F;
  --purple-mid: #24003D;
  --purple-rich: #4B0082;
  --purple-brand: #6A0DAD;
  --purple-glow: #9B30FF;
  --purple-light: #C084FC;
  --neon-pink: #FF2DF7;
  --neon-cyan: #00F5FF;
  --text-primary: #F0E6FF;
  --text-muted: #A78BCA;
  --glass-bg: rgba(106,13,173,0.18);
  --glass-border: rgba(155,48,255,0.35);
  --glass-blur: blur(18px);
  --radius: 14px;
  --radius-sm: 8px;
  --transition: 0.25s ease;
}
html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
body { font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple-deep) 0%, var(--purple-mid) 50%, var(--purple-rich) 100%); min-height: 100vh; color: var(--text-primary); line-height: 1.6; overflow-x: hidden; }
a { color: var(--purple-light); text-decoration: none; transition: color var(--transition); }
a:hover { color: var(--neon-pink); }
::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 6px; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: var(--purple-deep); }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--purple-brand); border-radius: 3px; }

/* NAVBAR */
.navbar { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 1000; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; padding: 0.75rem 2rem; background: rgba(13,0,31,0.7); backdrop-filter: var(--glass-blur); -webkit-backdrop-filter: var(--glass-blur); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--glass-border); transition: background var(--transition); }
.nav-brand .brand-text { font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 1px; color: var(--purple-light); text-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--purple-glow); }
.nav-links { list-style: none; display: flex; gap: 0.25rem; margin: 0 auto; }
.nav-item { position: relative; }
.nav-item > a { display: block; padding: 0.45rem 0.85rem; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-muted); transition: color var(--transition), background var(--transition); white-space: nowrap; }
.nav-item > a:hover, .nav-item:hover > a { color: var(--purple-light); background: var(--glass-bg); text-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--purple-glow); }
.dropdown { display: none; position: absolute; top: calc(100% + 6px); left: 0; list-style: none; background: rgba(13,0,31,0.92); backdrop-filter: var(--glass-blur); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); min-width: 170px; padding: 0.4rem 0; box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(106,13,173,0.4); z-index: 999; }
.nav-item:hover .dropdown { display: block; animation: fadeDown 0.18s ease; }
@keyframes fadeDown { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-6px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
.dropdown li a { display: block; padding: 0.45rem 1rem; font-size: 0.84rem; color: var(--text-muted); transition: color var(--transition), background var(--transition); }
.dropdown li a:hover { color: var(--neon-pink); background: rgba(255,45,247,0.08); }
.nav-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; }
.btn-search { background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; font-size: 1.1rem; color: var(--text-muted); padding: 0.35rem; border-radius: 50%; transition: color var(--transition), background var(--transition); }
.btn-search:hover { color: var(--neon-cyan); background: rgba(0,245,255,0.1); }
.btn-login { padding: 0.45rem 1.1rem; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple-brand), var(--purple-glow)); color: #fff; border-radius: 50px; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 700; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow var(--transition), transform var(--transition); box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(155,48,255,0.5); }
.btn-login:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 22px var(--neon-pink); transform: translateY(-1px); color: #fff; }
.hamburger { display: none; background: none; border: none; font-size: 1.5rem; color: var(--purple-light); cursor: pointer; }

/* SEARCH */
.search-overlay { display: none; position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(13,0,31,0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); z-index: 2000; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
.search-overlay.active { display: flex; }
.search-box { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; width: min(560px, 90vw); }
.search-box input { flex: 1; padding: 0.9rem 1.2rem; background: var(--glass-bg); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); border-radius: var(--radius); color: var(--text-primary); font-size: 1.05rem; outline: none; backdrop-filter: var(--glass-blur); }
.search-box input::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted); }
.search-box input:focus { border-color: var(--purple-glow); box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(155,48,255,0.4); }
#searchClose { padding: 0.9rem 1.1rem; background: rgba(255,45,247,0.15); border: 1px solid rgba(255,45,247,0.3); border-radius: var(--radius); color: var(--neon-pink); font-size: 1.1rem; cursor: pointer; }

/* HERO */
.hero { position: relative; min-height: 100vh; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-align: center; padding: 6rem 1.5rem 4rem; overflow: hidden; }
.hero-glow { position: absolute; width: 600px; height: 600px; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(106,13,173,0.35) 0%, transparent 70%); top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%,-50%); pointer-events: none; animation: pulse 4s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes pulse { 0%,100% { transform: translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1); opacity: 0.6; } 50% { transform: translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.12); opacity: 1; } }
.hero-content { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
.hero-logo { font-size: 5rem; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 20px var(--purple-glow)); animation: floatY 3s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes floatY { 0%,100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-10px); } }
.hero-title { font-size: clamp(2.8rem,7vw,5.5rem); font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 2px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple-light), var(--neon-pink)); -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; background-clip: text; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }
.hero-tagline { font-size: clamp(1rem,2.5vw,1.45rem); color: var(--purple-light); letter-spacing: 1px; margin-bottom: 0.35rem; text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(155,48,255,0.7); }
.hero-sub { font-size: 0.95rem; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 2rem; }
.hero-buttons { display: flex; gap: 1rem; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 2.5rem; }
.hero-stats { display: flex; gap: 2.5rem; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.stat { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 0.2rem; }
.stat-num { font-size: 1.6rem; font-weight: 800; color: var(--purple-light); text-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--purple-glow); }
.stat-label { font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; }

/* BUTTONS */
.btn-primary { display: inline-block; padding: 0.7rem 2rem; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple-brand), var(--purple-glow)); color: #fff; border-radius: 50px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.95rem; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow var(--transition), transform var(--transition); box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(155,48,255,0.5); text-decoration: none; }
.btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 28px var(--neon-pink); transform: translateY(-2px); color: #fff; }
.btn-primary.full { width: 100%; text-align: center; }
.btn-secondary { display: inline-block; padding: 0.7rem 2rem; background: transparent; color: var(--purple-light); border-radius: 50px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.95rem; border: 2px solid var(--purple-glow); cursor: pointer; transition: all var(--transition); text-decoration: none; }
.btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(155,48,255,0.15); box-shadow: 0 0 16px var(--purple-glow); color: var(--purple-light); }
.btn-discord { display: inline-block; margin-top: 1rem; padding: 0.6rem 1.4rem; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #5865F2, #7289DA); color: #fff; border-radius: 50px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.88rem; transition: box-shadow var(--transition), transform var(--transition); box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(88,101,242,0.5); }
.btn-discord:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 22px rgba(88,101,242,0.8); transform: translateY(-2px); color: #fff; }
.mt { margin-top: 1rem; }

/* ZONES */
.zone { padding: 5rem 2rem 4rem; max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; }
.zone-header { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 2.5rem; }
.zone-icon { font-size: 2.5rem; display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 10px var(--purple-glow)); }
.zone-header h2 { font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 800; color: var(--purple-light); text-shadow: 0 0 14px var(--purple-glow); margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }
.zone-header p { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.95rem; }
.zone-body { background: var(--glass-bg); backdrop-filter: var(--glass-blur); -webkit-backdrop-filter: var(--glass-blur); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 2rem; }

/* ARTIST GRID */
.artist-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(110px,1fr)); gap: 1rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
.artist-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 1rem 0.5rem; background: rgba(106,13,173,0.22); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); border-radius: var(--radius); cursor: pointer; transition: all var(--transition); text-align: center; font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--text-muted); }
.artist-card:hover { border-color: var(--neon-pink); box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(255,45,247,0.3); color: var(--text-primary); transform: translateY(-3px); }
.artist-thumb { font-size: 2rem; width: 54px; height: 54px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: rgba(106,13,173,0.4); border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid var(--glass-border); }
.upload-box { padding: 1rem 1.4rem; background: rgba(155,48,255,0.1); border: 1px dashed var(--purple-glow); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); text-align: center; font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--text-muted); }

/* GRIDS */
.room-grid, .games-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(160px,1fr)); gap: 1rem; }
.room-card, .game-card { padding: 1.2rem; background: rgba(106,13,173,0.22); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); border-radius: var(--radius); cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--text-muted); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; transition: all var(--transition); }
.room-card:hover, .game-card:hover { border-color: var(--neon-cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(0,245,255,0.25); color: var(--text-primary); transform: translateY(-2px); }
.room-card span, .game-card span { font-size: 1.3rem; }

/* COMMUNITY GAMES */
.community-games { margin-top: 2.5rem; padding-top: 2rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--glass-border); }
.community-games h3 { font-size: 1.3rem; color: var(--purple-light); margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }
.cg-note { font-size: 0.88rem; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 1.2rem; }
.cg-grid { display: flex; gap: 0.8rem; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }
.cg-card { padding: 0.7rem 1.2rem; background: rgba(88,101,242,0.15); border: 1px solid rgba(88,101,242,0.35); border-radius: 50px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.88rem; color: #A5B4FC; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; transition: all var(--transition); }
.cg-card:hover { background: rgba(88,101,242,0.3); color: #fff; }

/* WARNING */
.warning-banner { padding: 0.85rem 1.2rem; background: rgba(255,100,0,0.12); border: 1px solid rgba(255,100,0,0.4); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); color: #FFB347; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }

/* EMPTY STATE */
.empty-state { padding: 2.5rem; text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 1rem; border: 1px dashed var(--glass-border); border-radius: var(--radius); margin-bottom: 1rem; }

/* ABOUT */
.about-story { max-width: 700px; margin: 0 auto 2.5rem; line-height: 1.9; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.97rem; }
.about-story p { margin-bottom: 0.9rem; }
.about-story em { color: var(--purple-light); }
.founders-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px,1fr)); gap: 1.2rem; margin-bottom: 2rem; }
.founder-card { background: rgba(106,13,173,0.22); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 1.5rem 1rem; text-align: center; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; transition: all var(--transition); }
.founder-card:hover { border-color: var(--purple-glow); box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(155,48,255,0.25); transform: translateY(-2px); }
.founder-avatar { width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 50%; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple-brand), var(--purple-glow)); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 800; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 0.3rem; box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(155,48,255,0.5); }
.founder-card strong { color: var(--text-primary); font-size: 1rem; }
.founder-card span { font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--text-muted); }
.founder-card a { font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--purple-light); }
.badge { display: inline-block; padding: 0.15rem 0.5rem; background: rgba(155,48,255,0.2); border: 1px solid var(--purple-glow); border-radius: 50px; font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--purple-light); margin-left: 0.3rem; }
.contact-box { text-align: center; padding: 1.2rem; background: rgba(106,13,173,0.15); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.9rem; }
.contact-box a { color: var(--purple-light); }

/* FOOTER */
.footer { text-align: center; padding: 2.5rem 1rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--glass-border); background: rgba(13,0,31,0.5); }
.footer-links { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 1.5rem; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 0.8rem; }
.footer-links a { font-size: 0.88rem; color: var(--text-muted); }
.footer-links a:hover { color: var(--neon-pink); }
.footer-copy { font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--text-muted); }

/* TOAST */
.toast { position: fixed; bottom: 2rem; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(100px); background: rgba(13,0,31,0.92); border: 1px solid var(--purple-glow); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 0.85rem 1.5rem; color: var(--text-primary); font-size: 0.9rem; z-index: 9999; transition: transform 0.35s ease; backdrop-filter: var(--glass-blur); box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(155,48,255,0.4); }
.toast.show { transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); }
.toast a { color: var(--neon-pink); font-weight: 700; }

/* LOGIN PAGE */
body.login-page { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 100vh; }
.login-wrap { display: flex; width: min(900px,96vw); min-height: 520px; background: var(--glass-bg); backdrop-filter: var(--glass-blur); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); border-radius: 20px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 0 60px rgba(106,13,173,0.5); }
.login-left { flex: 1; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple-deep), var(--purple-rich)); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 2rem; border-right: 1px solid var(--glass-border); }
.login-brand { text-align: center; }
.login-logo { font-size: 5rem; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 20px var(--purple-glow)); animation: floatY 3s ease-in-out infinite; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }
.login-brand h1 { font-size: 2.4rem; font-weight: 900; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple-light), var(--neon-pink)); -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; background-clip: text; }
.login-brand p { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.9rem; margin-top: 0.3rem; }
.login-right { flex: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 2.5rem; }
.login-step { display: none; width: 100%; }
.login-step.active { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; }
.avatar-circle { width: 100px; height: 100px; border-radius: 50%; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple-brand), var(--purple-glow)); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 2.5rem; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 0 24px var(--purple-glow); transition: all var(--transition); border: 3px solid var(--glass-border); }
.avatar-circle:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 36px var(--neon-pink); transform: scale(1.06); }
.step-hint { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.9rem; }
.login-step h2 { font-size: 1.4rem; color: var(--purple-light); text-align: center; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }
form { width: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.75rem; }
form input { padding: 0.8rem 1rem; background: rgba(106,13,173,0.18); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); color: var(--text-primary); font-size: 0.95rem; outline: none; transition: border-color var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition); }
form input::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted); }
form input:focus { border-color: var(--purple-glow); box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(155,48,255,0.3); }
.switch-link { font-size: 0.83rem; color: var(--text-muted); text-align: center; }
.switch-link a { color: var(--purple-light); }

/* MOBILE */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .nav-links { display: none; }
  .hamburger { display: block; }
  .nav-links.open { display: flex; flex-direction: column; position: fixed; top: 60px; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; background: rgba(13,0,31,0.97); padding: 1.5rem; z-index: 999; overflow-y: auto; }
  .nav-links.open .dropdown { display: block; position: static; box-shadow: none; border: none; background: transparent; padding-left: 1rem; }
  .hero-title { font-size: 2.8rem; }
  .login-wrap { flex-direction: column; min-height: auto; }
  .login-left { border-right: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--glass-border); padding: 1.5rem; }
  .zone { padding: 4rem 1rem 2.5rem; }
}
lunara-script.js
/* LUNARA HUB — script.js */
const SESSION_KEY = 'lunara_user';
function getUser() { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SESSION_KEY)); } catch { return null; } }
function setUser(u) { localStorage.setItem(SESSION_KEY, JSON.stringify(u)); }
function logout() { localStorage.removeItem(SESSION_KEY); location.reload(); }

function updateNavAvatar() {
  const user = getUser();
  const btn = document.querySelector('.btn-login');
  if (!btn) return;
  if (user) {
    btn.textContent = user.name ? user.name[0].toUpperCase() : '👤';
    btn.style.cssText = 'width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;padding:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:800;font-size:1rem;cursor:pointer;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#6A0DAD,#9B30FF);border:none;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(155,48,255,0.5);';
    btn.title = user.name || user.email;
    btn.onclick = function(e) { e.preventDefault(); showProfileMenu(btn); };
  }
}

function showProfileMenu(anchor) {
  const existing = document.getElementById('profileMenu');
  if (existing) { existing.remove(); return; }
  const menu = document.createElement('div');
  menu.id = 'profileMenu';
  menu.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;top:60px;right:1.5rem;background:rgba(13,0,31,0.97);border:1px solid rgba(155,48,255,0.4);border-radius:12px;padding:0.6rem 0;min-width:200px;z-index:3000;backdrop-filter:blur(18px);box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(106,13,173,0.5);';
  [
    { label: '👤 Edit Profile Picture', action: editProfilePicture },
    { label: '✏️ Edit Name', action: editName },
    { label: '📞 Contact Developer', action: () => window.open('tel:+917676387443') },
    { label: '🚪 Logout', action: logout },
  ].forEach(item => {
    const b = document.createElement('button');
    b.textContent = item.label;
    b.style.cssText = 'display:block;width:100%;padding:0.6rem 1.2rem;background:none;border:none;color:#C084FC;font-size:0.9rem;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;';
    b.onmouseenter = () => b.style.background = 'rgba(106,13,173,0.3)';
    b.onmouseleave = () => b.style.background = 'none';
    b.onclick = () => { menu.remove(); item.action(); };
    menu.appendChild(b);
  });
  document.body.appendChild(menu);
  setTimeout(() => document.addEventListener('click', function h(e) {
    if (!menu.contains(e.target) && e.target !== anchor) { menu.remove(); document.removeEventListener('click', h); }
  }), 50);
}

function editProfilePicture() {
  const input = document.createElement('input');
  input.type = 'file'; input.accept = 'image/*';
  input.onchange = () => {
    const file = input.files[0]; if (!file) return;
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = () => { const u = getUser() || {}; u.avatar = reader.result; setUser(u); updateNavAvatar(); showToast('Profile picture updated!'); };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  };
  input.click();
}

function editName() {
  const u = getUser() || {};
  const n = prompt('Enter your new display name:', u.name || '');
  if (n && n.trim()) { u.name = n.trim(); setUser(u); updateNavAvatar(); showToast('Name updated!'); }
}

function requireLogin() {
  if (getUser()) return true;
  showToast('🔒 Please <a href="login.html">login</a> to use this feature.');
  return false;
}

function showToast(msg) {
  const t = document.getElementById('loginToast');
  if (!t) return;
  t.innerHTML = msg; t.classList.add('show');
  clearTimeout(t._timer);
  t._timer = setTimeout(() => t.classList.remove('show'), 3500);
}

function initHamburger() {
  const btn = document.getElementById('hamburger');
  const links = document.querySelector('.nav-links');
  if (btn && links) btn.addEventListener('click', () => links.classList.toggle('open'));
}

function initSearch() {
  const toggle = document.getElementById('searchToggle');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('searchOverlay');
  const close = document.getElementById('searchClose');
  const input = document.getElementById('searchInput');
  if (!toggle) return;
  const sections = [
    { id: 'soundscape', label: 'Soundscape Music' },
    { id: 'art',        label: 'PixelLand Art' },
    { id: 'chatrooms',  label: 'Chat Rooms' },
    { id: 'games',      label: 'Tlunara JDM Arcade Games' },
    { id: 'marketplace',label: 'Moon Cart Marketplace Players' },
    { id: 'strategy',   label: 'Mainline Tech Strategy VC' },
    { id: 'tech',       label: 'Oxide Tech Aloxide' },
    { id: 'competition',label: 'Oxide Competition' },
    { id: 'about',      label: 'About Lunara' },
  ];
  toggle.addEventListener('click', () => { overlay.classList.add('active'); setTimeout(() => input && input.focus(), 100); });
  close && close.addEventListener('click', () => overlay.classList.remove('active'));
  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key === 'k') { e.preventDefault(); overlay.classList.add('active'); setTimeout(() => input && input.focus(), 100); }
    if (e.key === 'Escape') overlay.classList.remove('active');
  });
  input && input.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      const q = input.value.trim().toLowerCase();
      const match = sections.find(s => s.label.toLowerCase().includes(q) || s.id.includes(q));
      if (match) { overlay.classList.remove('active'); document.getElementById(match.id)?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' }); }
      else showToast('Section not found: ' + input.value);
    }
  });
}

function initCountdown() {
  const el = document.getElementById('countdown');
  if (!el) return;
  function update() {
    const now = new Date(), next = new Date(now);
    next.setHours(24,0,0,0);
    const d = next - now;
    const h = Math.floor(d/3600000), m = Math.floor((d%3600000)/60000), s = Math.floor((d%60000)/1000);
    el.textContent = `${String(h).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(m).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(s).padStart(2,'0')}`;
  }
  update(); setInterval(update, 1000);
}

function initNavScroll() {
  const nav = document.getElementById('navbar');
  if (!nav) return;
  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    nav.style.background = window.scrollY > 10 ? 'rgba(13,0,31,0.92)' : 'rgba(13,0,31,0.7)';
  });
}

function goStep(id) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.login-step').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById(id)?.classList.add('active');
}

function initLoginPage() {
  const picker = document.getElementById('avatarPickerBtn');
  if (picker) picker.addEventListener('click', () => goStep('step-signin'));
  const signinForm = document.getElementById('signinForm');
  if (signinForm) signinForm.addEventListener('submit', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const email = document.getElementById('signinEmail').value.trim();
    const pass = document.getElementById('signinPassword').value;
    const users = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('lunara_users') || '[]');
    const user = users.find(u => u.email === email && u.password === pass);
    if (user) { setUser(user); window.location.href = 'lunara-site.html'; }
    else alert('Incorrect email or password. Please register first.');
  });
  const regForm = document.getElementById('registerForm');
  if (regForm) regForm.addEventListener('submit', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const name = document.getElementById('regName').value.trim();
    const email = document.getElementById('regEmail').value.trim();
    const pass = document.getElementById('regPassword').value;
    const users = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('lunara_users') || '[]');
    if (users.find(u => u.email === email)) { alert('Account exists. Please sign in.'); return; }
    const newUser = { name, email, password: pass, isAdmin: email === 'katariavianyt45@gmail.com', createdAt: Date.now() };
    users.push(newUser);
    localStorage.setItem('lunara_users', JSON.stringify(users));
    setUser(newUser);
    window.location.href = 'lunara-site.html';
  });
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  updateNavAvatar();
  initHamburger();
  initSearch();
  initCountdown();
  initNavScroll();
  initLoginPage();
});
